---
title: "14 — Run the three additional insight analyses"
output: html_notebook
---

**Purpose:** run the additional research diagnostics as part of the complete
study workflow. This notebook does not retrain any model. It reads the frozen
model and 2023–2025 checkpoints from the current numbered run and writes the
additional charts, tables, and notebook HTML to that same run.

## Attach the frozen model run

The runner selects the most recent run that has the required saved model and
scored data. To choose a specific run, set `ATG_ADDON_SOURCE_RUN_ID` before
knitting, e.g. `Sys.setenv(ATG_ADDON_SOURCE_RUN_ID = "0001")`.

```{r initialize}
# Locate the project before accessing shared functions or output folders.
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
    current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
    repeat {
        if (file.exists(file.path(current, "FMD_Project.Rproj"))) {
            return(current)
        }
        parent <- dirname(current)
        if (identical(parent, current)) {
            stop("Open FMD_Project.Rproj in RStudio first")
        }
        current <- parent
    }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

# Load all R expressions from a shared .Rmd module without calling source() on an Rmd.
load_module <- function(name) {
    path <- file.path(project_root, "R", paste0(name, ".Rmd"))
    lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
    starts <- which(startsWith(lines, "```{r"))
    ends <- which(trimws(lines) == "```")
    blocks <- lapply(starts, function(start) {
        finish <- ends[ends > start][1]
        if (is.na(finish) || finish <= start + 1L) {
            stop("Incomplete code chunk in ", path)
        }
        paste(lines[(start + 1L):(finish - 1L)], collapse = "\n")
    })
    eval(parse(text = paste(blocks, collapse = "\n\n")), envir = parent.frame())
    invisible(TRUE)
}

load_module("config")
load_module("run_manager")
load_module("helpers")
load_module("addon_insight_helpers")
check_packages(c("data.table", "ggplot2", "rmarkdown", "scales"))

# When called from the master notebook, use its current run as the source.
# This keeps every result in one numbered execution.
original_dir <- file.path(project_root, "outputs")
existing <- list.dirs(original_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
possible <- sub("^run_", "", existing[grepl("^run_[0-9]{4,}$", existing)])

source_complete <- function(run_id) {
    original <- file.path(original_dir, paste0("run_", run_id))
    needed <- c(
        file.path("models", sprintf("05_frozen_selection_run_%s.rds", run_id)),
        file.path("checkpoints", sprintf("02_selection_2023_run_%s.rds", run_id)),
        file.path("checkpoints", sprintf("02_calibration_2024_run_%s.rds", run_id)),
        file.path("checkpoints", sprintf("07_scored_2025_run_%s.rds", run_id))
    )
    if (!all(file.exists(file.path(original, needed)))) {
        return(FALSE)
    }
    chosen <- readRDS(file.path(
        original, "models", sprintf("05_frozen_selection_run_%s.rds", run_id)
    ))$chosen_family
    file.exists(file.path(
        original, "models", sprintf("05_%s_run_%s.rds", chosen, run_id)
    ))
}

current_run <- Sys.getenv("ATG_RUN_ID", unset = "")
if (nzchar(current_run)) {
    original_id <- current_run
    addon_id <- current_run
    run_context <- attach_run()
} else {
    # Preserve standalone execution for reviewing an already completed run.
    ready <- possible[vapply(possible, source_complete, logical(1))]
    requested <- Sys.getenv("ATG_ADDON_SOURCE_RUN_ID", unset = "")
    if (nzchar(requested)) {
        if (!requested %in% ready) {
            stop("Requested source run is missing a required model or checkpoint: ", requested)
        }
        original_id <- requested
    } else {
        if (!length(ready)) {
            stop("No complete source run found. Run the existing study first.")
        }
        original_id <- ready[which.max(as.integer(ready))]
    }
    Sys.unsetenv("ATG_RUN_ID")
    addon_id <- start_new_run()
    run_context <- attach_run()
}
Sys.setenv(ATG_SOURCE_RUN_ID = original_id)

# Save traceable provenance without copying fitted models or source data.
metadata <- data.frame(
    addon_run = addon_id,
    frozen_source_run = original_id,
    method = "frozen-model additional diagnostics",
    timestamp = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")
)
save_table(metadata, "14_addon_source_provenance")
print(metadata)
```

## Execute the additional notebooks

The three analyses reuse the same source model and the current numbered run.
Graphs will appear in each rendered notebook and be saved to that run folder.

```{r execute-addons}
# Run the three additional analyses as part of the current master execution.
stages <- c(
    "15_Predictor_Changes_Across_Years.Rmd",
    "16_Composition_Standardization.Rmd",
    "17_Standardized_Gap_Uncertainty.Rmd"
)

for (stage in stages) {
    output_name <- sprintf(
        "%s_run_%s.nb.html",
        tools::file_path_sans_ext(stage),
        addon_id
    )
    cat("[ADD-ON] ", stage, " | run ", addon_id, "\n", sep = "")
    rmarkdown::render(
        input = file.path(project_root, "notebooks", stage),
        output_file = output_name,
        output_dir = run_context$notebooks,
        knit_root_dir = project_root,
        envir = new.env(parent = globalenv()),
        quiet = FALSE
    )
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

cat("[COMPLETE] New diagnostic results in:", run_context$root, "\n")
Sys.unsetenv(c("ATG_SOURCE_RUN_ID", "ATG_RUN_ID"))
```
